sources.name: Banking Association South Africa - Complaints procedures in the banking industry
National Financial Ombud Scheme (formerly Ombudsman for Banking Services)
FirstRand Bank EFT terms of use

entries.subject: ombudsman_claim_ceiling
entries.display: The banking ombud can consider claims of R2 million or less
entries.quote: Involves a claim of R2m or less
entries.notes: One of four OBS jurisdictional requirements listed by BASA. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: ombudsman_time_bar
entries.display: The complaint must have arisen within the past three years
entries.notes: OBS jurisdictional requirement. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: ombudsman_legal_basis
entries.display: The Ombudsman for Banking Services was established under the Financial Services Ombud Schemes Act 37 of 2004
entries.quote: The Ombudsman for Banking Services scheme (the OBS) was established under the Financial Services Ombud Schemes Act, No. 37 of 2004.

entries.subject: nfo_merger
entries.display: The OBS now sits inside the National Financial Ombud Scheme, which merges four former ombuds and is free
entries.quote: The NFO is a single, one-stop, all-in-one dispute resolution service made up 4 former longstanding services: Banking Ombud (OBS); the Credit Ombud (CO); the Long-term Insurance Ombud (OLTI); and the Short-Term Insurance Ombud (OSTI).
entries.notes: The same page states the NFO's services are free of charge. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: complaint_reference_sla
entries.display: Standard Bank issues a complaint reference number within 24 hours
entries.quote: A reference number within 24 hours after you’ve lodged the complaint.
entries.notes: Bank's published complaints process; page undated.

entries.subject: case_manager_sla
entries.display: A case manager reverts to the complainant within 24 hours
entries.quote: The details of a case manager who will manage your complaint, and who will revert to you within 24 hours.

entries.subject: ombudsman_lodging_window
entries.display: Ombudsman complaints are usually lodged within four to six months of the bank's outcome
entries.quote: The ombudsman and regulators usually require complaints to be lodged within four to six months after you’ve received an outcome from us.
entries.notes: Range 4-6 months; five is the midpoint.

entries.subject: dispute_reversal_window
entries.display: A disputed debit declared within 40 calendar days is reversed immediately by the bank
entries.quote: The Bank will immediately reverse the disputed payment instruction/s in instances where a dispute declaration is submitted within 40 calendar days from action date of the payment instruction being processed.
entries.notes: After 40 days the user must supply the mandate and the dispute follows a longer process.

entries.subject: str_duty
entries.display: Possible money laundering transactions must be brought to the attention of investigating authorities
entries.quote: possible money laundering transactions must be brought to the attention of investigating authorities
entries.notes: FIC states the detection principle behind suspicious transaction reporting; no STR deadline is stated in this guidance note.

notes: Complaint-handling facts come from BASA, the National Financial Ombud Scheme site and Standard Bank's complaints process. Reversal timelines come from FirstRand's EFT terms. No source in this corpus states a STR filing deadline or chargeback scheme rule in detail, so those are not asserted.
